title: Virtual Card Management: How to Instantly Issue a Virtual Card
summary: This document explains how to instantly issue a Virtual card by navigating to Cards > Virtual > Create new card, completing required fields, and confirming. With instant issuance enabled (Yes), card details appear in about 5 seconds; it also covers what to verify (card number, expiry, security code) and common fixes (refresh list, re-check setting, re-submit).
